tool_input.command:
git add internal/doctor/doctor.go internal/doctor/doctor_test.go && git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
fix(doctor): LOW — surface core.hooksPath warnings, distinguish I/O errors from absence

githook.HooksDir's second return value (a warning when core.hooksPath
diverts hooks inside the tracked work tree, or entirely outside the
repo) was discarded at both call sites (`dir, _ :=`) in
checkHookPresence and CheckHookCurrency — doctor is the one surface
already inspecting hook state closely enough to say it, and silently
dropped it instead. Both now append the warning(s) to Detail via a
named return + defer, so the message rides along on whatever
PASS/WARN/FAIL the rest of the check produces.

classifyOrphans treated every identity.Load error the same as
os.ErrNotExist — "no matching identity anywhere, investigate before
deleting" — even when the file exists but couldn't be read (a
permission error, malformed YAML). Now a three-way split: nil error is
stale, errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) is genuinely unresolved, and
anything else is a new "could not resolve" bucket naming that a file
does exist and why it failed to load.

Falsified against pre-fix source with a regression test each.
EOF
)"
